diagnosis.rootCause: The synthetic modeler populated dataStorageData and set hasDataStorageRecord=true but left hasDsData false. The assertion expected hasDataStorageBinaryData() to be true; that accessor reads the separate hasDsData bit.
diagnosis.resolution: Call setHasDataStorageBinaryData(true) when constructing the positive in-memory test record.
diagnosis.diagnosticImprovement: Self-test failures now report their source line; the modeler assertion reports field values, carrier count, and expected carrier-presence booleans.

changes.detail: Made the positive synthetic DataStorage record internally consistent with its advertised binary-data bit and expected semantic output; retained actionable failure diagnostics.
Marked the previous red probe as resolved and recorded the focused diagnosis, validation, and remaining receipt/qualification gates.
